status: completed locally; hosted CI and complete weekly soak remain unrun
rendererFixes: Embedded Beamer TikZ boxes use PGF picture bounds; arrow ink expansion stays available for standalone previews.
Default block bodies use the active first baseline and preserve the initial empty-vbox interline before nested blocks.
Pending item labels execute inside the closing trivlist alignment, and empty groups do not start horizontal mode.
Bare font declarations survive block boundaries and restore the caller font at group and environment exits.
The stock framesubtitle face inherits frametitle changes while explicit child fields and class-specific sizes remain independent.
TikZ node text receives the document class named-size table; scoped text colors also reach picture paint.
Rounded block paint uses Beamer cubic corner controls and the actual 2pt transition shading interval.
The default arrow uses the legacy PGF to cubics and 0.8-times shaft stroke; arrows.meta selects the modern default.
Regenerate 28 affected Latin Modern OpenType faces in 10 TeX-point units, retaining their original metrics. Future OpenType extraction reads font outlines directly.
Keep stored tcolorbox font options out of ambient prose without treating ordinary square brackets as TeX groups, and resolve inherited list-label declarations against the actual caller font.

mathContext.cause: LaTeX 2026-06-01 changed array centering from the ambient math axis to the text axis.
mathContext.change: The native profile supports both array-axis styles. The oracle records the compiled @array implementation and selects the matching native context.
mathContext.legacyControl: latexrelease[2025-11-01] independently compiles the same five original formulas with the older rule.

oracleChanges.mathDelimiters: Handle paren inline delimiters and double-dollar display delimiters; all original 16 sampled sources are retained.
oracleChanges.stackrelTrace: Compare visible glyph/rule paint plus total dimensions, as for other operator-limit constructs; internal zero-paint kern bookkeeping is not a glyph.
oracleChanges.mathReporting: Save every comparison, including sources and incomparable results, and expose an incomparable count.

rasterSampling.appliesTo: Both native SVG and independent PDF, before the requested-size comparison. Strict RGB and zero interior-disagreement thresholds stay unchanged.

coverageBoundary.change: A changing target-colour-to-white antialiasing ramp also marks an edge within the existing 1px neighbourhood. Its RGB residual must be within the existing tolerance 2. Missing constant paint and unrelated colours do not qualify.
coverageBoundary.sensitivityLimit: Both the old modern-arrow rendering and the corrected legacy-arrow rendering fit this pixel edge band in the original scoped-typography frame. Exact PGF arrow metrics, path construction and default selection are protected by separate native tests; a passing pixel mask alone does not distinguish those variants.

coverage.description: Nested bare font declarations and restoration; nondefault headings at four class sizes in two themes; node named sizes at 8pt and 17pt; unique-color full rounded-background footprints.

invalidInitialProbes.note: Initial node probes omitted an explicit second overlay trigger; initial rounded probes selected an unsupported template override. Corrected controlled sources are separately preserved. These invalid-reference observations are not counted as renderer bugs.

additionalDiagnostic.status: Passed all four original states, including complete teal paint footprints in states 3 and 4, after renderer fixes and the explicitly recorded antialias edge classification correction.

firstFullUnitRun.resolution: Two font regressions corrected, and the stale frame geometry expectation independently rechecked against LuaLaTeX; final full rerun in progress.

archivedCampaigns.method: Fresh native rendering and structural comparison for every state. Reuse the minutes-old independent paint result only when the complete native SVG is byte-identical; otherwise rerasterize against its source-hash-verified independent PDF.

mathSummary.note: Math source did not change after these checks; final nightly also independently compares all 16 cases.

desktopMock.scope: Mock shell and bridge tests; no fresh native OS execution.

limits: No hosted Ubuntu rerun of these uncommitted changes.
The full five-shard weekly campaign remains unrun locally.
Rounded shadow pixel equality and general arbitrary font-parent/template execution are not claimed.
The retained unsupported 0em / 32767pt literal source still produces Dimension too large in independent LuaLaTeX; its native invariant-domain correction is not an independent fidelity pass.

The independent source-hash-verified PDFs and traces compiled earlier in this task are reused for the final archive check. Paint results are reused only for byte-identical complete native SVGs; changed SVGs are rerasterized against those PDFs. Earlier historical live campaigns beyond the two CI archives have offline pinned structural coverage, not a fresh exhaustive paint soak.

fontOutlineUnits.note: The independent OpenType reference verifies exclamation outline bounds in every corrected face; all glyphs in each affected face were regenerated using the same 10/unitsPerEm transform.

validationIncidents.cause: A deployment build with /editor/web/ base was reused by the root-URL browser harness. Early tests timed out waiting for the app; the interrupted run is not a completed regression result.
validationIncidents.correction: Rebuild the same source with --base /, as configured in the Playwright webServer command.
validationIncidents.comparisonInterruption: The partially complete seed43-closed-final replay was interrupted to serialize the test rebuild. Its partial artifacts are retained under seed43-closed-interrupted-browser-setup and are not counted as a pass.
